title: Hands coming together when excitement rises
summary: Most children clap when they are excited by about 15 months, the milestone sheet says.
body: The clap is a body way of showing a stirred, pleased state. sheet lists it on its own, apart from hugs and kisses. Nothing on the line says clapping is the only acceptable sign of excitement. The series counts what most children do, 75 percent or more, and the sheet is not a formal screen. The age is from the US page.

sources.title: Milestones by 15 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports the social/emotional milestone 'Claps when excited'.
